description:
Pumpynotes brings a calendar, block-based notes and multi-currency personal finance into one workspace. Connect it to ChatGPT to plan, write and keep track of money from the conversation.

ChatGPT can list and read your calendar events, including recurring ones; create and edit events; search and read your notes; create notes and add to them; see your wallets and transactions; summarize income, spending by category and budget status; and record or edit one-off income and expenses.

ChatGPT only sees what you can see in the one workspace you choose when connecting, and view-only shared items stay read-only. The app cannot delete anything and only records bookkeeping entries: it never moves real money.

Works with a Pumpynotes account on the Pro, Business or Enterprise plan.

defaultPrompt: What's on my calendar this week?
Summarize my spending this month by category.
Add a dentist appointment tomorrow at 2 pm.
